dashboard.label: TA-disk Metrics
dashboard.description: Index-time metrics over index=metrics (sourcetype disk:metrics); series prefixed 'disk.'.

panel.title: All disk.* series (fleet counts + per-disk attrs where SMART is readable)

search.query: | mstats avg("disk.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "disk.*"

panel.title: Temperature (C, per disk - where SMART is readable)

search.query: | mstats avg("disk.*temperature") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "disk.*temperature"
| mstats avg("disk.*power_on_hours") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "disk.*power_on_hours"
| mstats avg("disk.*percentage_used") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "disk.*percentage_used"
| mstats avg("disk.*available_spare") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "disk.*available_spare"
| mstats avg("disk.*realloc_raw") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "disk.*realloc_raw"
